meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行把脚本化的分镜、音频渲染成成片视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要按固定流程把素材渲染成视频并批量导出发布
copy.tagline_en: Render scripted compositions and audio into finished videos from the terminal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly render assets into videos and ship them in batches

howto.what: 它让 Claude 用 npx hyperframes 走开发循环:建项目、找动效、检查等步骤,直到预览并渲染出视频,也能诊断构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要求做 HyperFrames 视频的建项目、渲染等 CLI 工作,或排查构建、渲染失败时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes init 新建一个视频项目
say.note: 会脚手架出一个居中空白项目

say.text: 搜索 catalog 里有没有逐行显示标题的动效
say.note: 在本地词表里搜索,再决定要不要 add

say.text: 先跑 hyperframes check,再给我预览链接
say.note: 检查通过后才打开预览

howto.what_en: It has Claude run the HyperFrames CLI loop with npx hyperframes: scaffold, find motion, check and so on through to preview and render, plus diagnosing build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for HyperFrames CLI work such as scaffolding or rendering, or when diagnosing a build or render failure.

say_en.text: Scaffold a new video project with hyperframes init
Search the catalog for a motion that reveals a headline line by line
Run hyperframes check first, then give me the preview link
